# Thinking

`import { Thinking, ShimmerText } from "@/components/agent-ui/thinking"`

## Use for
- The reasoning phase of a reasoning model, before the answer text arrives.
- `ShimmerText` alone for short in-progress labels ("Searching the web").

## Do not use for
- Page or data loading. Use the project's `Skeleton` or `Spinner`.
- Tool execution progress. Use `ToolCall` with `status="running"`.

## Props
| Prop | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `boolean` | Required. `true` shimmers the label, `false` shows `doneLabel`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Reasoning text. When absent the header is not clickable. |
| `duration` | `number` | Seconds. If omitted, measured from `active` true to false. |
| `label` | `string` | Default `"Thinking"`. |
| `doneLabel` | `(s) => string` | Default `` s => `Thought for ${s}s` ``. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | Default `false`. Keep reasoning collapsed unless the product is a debugging tool. |

## Example
```tsx
<Thinking active={phase === "reasoning"}>{reasoningText}</Thinking>
<Message role="assistant" streaming={phase === "answering"}>{answer}</Message>
```

## Rules
- Set `active` from the stream: true on the first reasoning chunk, false on the first answer chunk.
- One Thinking per assistant turn, placed above that turn's Message.
- Shimmer respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. Do not add your own animation on top.
